# Your rotating shift schedule, as a calendar

> Generate a rotating shift schedule for Pitman 2-2-3, 4-on-4-off, 3-on-3-off, DuPont and 24/48 patterns: see hours per week, weekends off and days off per year, find your crew, and export an .ics calendar. Free, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
